message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for 9×13 in. pan, 8–10 servings) |
|----------|------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (≈ 450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Sugar (optional, to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella | 3–4 cups (≈ 300 g) |
| **Parmesan topping** | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, sautéed & drained) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Ricotta or cottage cheese (for a lighter version) | 1 cup |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if using regular ones) until al dente, then drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment or lightly oiled tray to prevent sticking.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: Sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, seasonings, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare ricotta mix**: Combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Assemble**: Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta mixture, and mozzarella in a 9×13 pan. Repeat layers, finishing with sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan on top.
5. **Bake**: Cover with foil (to prevent sticking, tent it slightly) and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min. Remove foil and bake another 15–20 min until bubbly and golden.
6. **Rest**: Let stand 10–15 min before slicing.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
